content_zh:
庶女的生存法则
代王府是山西地界最高品秩的权贵，这回的团年宴几乎攘括了大同地界有头有脸的人物，其中，京里来的靖王李骁也应邀在此列，不过男女有别，并没有共处一室。所有男客都在前头由代王爷及其世子招待。而后院里的女着在用完午饭后便借口家中还有老母，或家中尝有稚子无人照顾为由，纷纷离去。
代王妃虽然不解这些平时候最爱钻营的女人怎么今天全屁股着火，但今天她精神确实不大好，刚才又因女儿的关系开罪了镇国将军。而镇军将军方知义又与京里的靖王李骁交好，而李骁目前暂且节制山西军务，手下还有大太监汪直，及锦衣卫同知张由等人。代王妃虽不懂政事，但也知道，皇帝虽然圈禁了老王爷，但对代王府一直心存忌惮，总要想方设法捉出代王府的污点。李骁与代王虽是叔侄，但天家亲戚，犹是薄弱。再来最近几月里，李骁的行事做派，没有一项是为着代王府的。而大太监汪直与锦衣卫同知张由，虽明里是来监督山西军务，但谁不知这是皇帝的眼线？如今代王府看着风光，实则如覆薄冰，稍不注意就会掉进万丈深渊。而刚才自己女儿对镇国将军的妹子一番轻视与怠慢，她不敢再往下想了。希望她多虑吧，也希望她打听来的消息是正确的，堂堂嫡系出身的方知义，如何会紧着一个庶出的妹子呢？
但尽管如何，代王妃仍是舍下老脸，在如情快要离去时，亲自拉着如晴的手，好一通道歉，“刚才我儿多有得罪，还请姑娘不要放心上。我那丫头年轻气盛，不懂事，若有开罪的地方，还请姑娘多多海涵。”说着又从丫头手中拿过一个檀木制的盒子亲自递与如晴手上，“这是与你的一点儿小心意，算是给姑娘压压惊，还忘姑娘笑纳。”
如晴接过檀木盒子，鲁闻到一股淡淡的檀香味，心里惊异，这些王府果真奢侈，连装东西的盒子都这么名贵，也难怪皇帝会忌惮并着手削番了，实是这些龙子凤孙们，不事生产，只吃道吃喝拉撒，还特爱惹事生非，托天家后腿，并且还特别能生能养，再这样继续下去，大庆朝的国库都要被吃空了。
不过，腹诽归腹诽，如情却扭不过代王妃的坚持，只得收下，但这回却收得有点儿心虚，她望着代王妃那用上等胭脂都遮不住的苍老面孔，很是愧疚，“你女儿与两广总督家的婚事估计已被我给搅黄了。如今该道歉收的人应该是我吧？”想着与她同桌的那名洪夫人，见她帕子上的灰绿颜色，当场就变了颜色，然后又替她张罗碗筷，期间还特意与别的贵妇调换了位置坐到她对面，对她虚寒问暖的。此人不是别人，正是代王府郡主的未来婆婆，辖制两广的总督府夫人。
如晴抱着沉甸甸的盒子，出了仪门，上了马车，犹在心里想着，嘿，受一回委屈就发如此大财。但又想着这算不算是受贿？
正胡思乱想，忽然外头传来一个熟悉的傲慢的声音，“站住。”
李骁骑在高头大马上，一身玄黑貂皮锦氅衬得气度不凡，白色的貂皮帽上，镶着一颗明晃晃的宝石，与帽檐下的炯炯双眸相互映衬，煞是威武。
“站住，本王有话与你说。”李骁勒着缰绳，**骏马横立在如情车前，迫使车夫不得不停勒住了缰绳，对李骁拱手见礼，“王爷，我家姑娘轻易不得见外男，王爷有什么话与小老儿说便成。”
李骁轻哼一声，抖了抖马鞭，傲然道：“本王只与你家姑娘说两句话便走。”
坐在车厢里的玲珑心里惊了惊，一脸担忧地望着如情，“姑娘，这人果然来找麻烦了。”
如情文静坐在铺有湘潭锦绒毛毯的垫子上，只微微掀开帘子一角，轻脆答道：“王爷，奴家这厢有礼了。请问王爷有何指教？”
李骁又策马向前，靠近如情的窗前，见如情只微微掀开帘子一角，只露半边脸儿，脸色沉了沉，居然临下，沉声问道：“本王先前送的礼物姑娘可还喜欢？”
如情愣了下，李骁也送了礼物给她？她怎么不知道？狐疑的目光望着李骁，发现他正以期待的神情等着她的答案，心里冒过某些念头，嘴里却道：“喜欢，王爷有心了。如情都还没有亲自给王爷道谢呢。”
这下子轮到李骁狐疑了，本想弯腰仔细打量一番，哪知如情却干脆放下帘子，只从车里传出一句闷闷的话来：“王爷请自重。”
李骁立马直了弯，脸上、心里都火辣辣的一片。
车窗的帘子再度掀开一角，露出如情水汪汪的大眼，“王爷还有何请教？”
“……”李骁忽然有瞬间的呆滞，近距离打量，他才陡然惊觉这小丫头的双眼真的好好看，像蓝天白云下波光鳞鳞的湖水，又像深山里的清泉，更像天上落下凡间的宝石，散发出诱人的星茫，有着俏皮，还有着星星点点的作恶意味。
如情又冲他轻轻地笑了，扑闪着一双大眼，“既然没事了，那如情就先走一步。”

“等等。”李骁又叫住她。等如情又掀了帘子后，忽然又找不着叫她停下来的理由了。
“王爷还有事么？”
“……”李骁盯了她一会儿，忽然责问：“前阵子将军府差了人送礼物与我，都是你准备的么？”
如情笑得腼腆，“是呀，王爷与哥哥乃莫逆之交，哥哥一个大粗人，哪懂得备礼这些俗事，所以如情这才代哥哥亲自给王爷备了礼物。王爷可还喜欢？”
李骁脸色黑了大半，只冷着声问：“是谁让你送我药酒，还有那些……药材？”
如情扑闪着美丽的大眼，一脸无辜，“如情看过医书呀，用枸杞、山茱萸、巴戟天、石菖蒲、地骨皮、覆盆子、菟丝子……”
“够了。”李骁见她当真背出来，连忙制止，脸色更黑，阴沉沉地瞪着她，“你一个姑娘家，也好意思拿这些当礼物？”
如情扑闪着无辜的大眼，不解道：“知道呀，王爷府里有两个侧妃，四个妾室，如今王爷身边还有好几位通房，如情想着兴许王爷应该用得着……”她很是诚挚地望着李骁，“怎么，王爷不喜欢？为了给王爷准备礼物，如情还特意请教过药铺里的大夫呢……”如情仿佛这时候才发现李骁脸色不对劲，一副头顶快冒烟的模样，吞吞口水，小小声道：“呃，王爷，是不是嫌牛鞭和虎骨小了？这也不能怪如情，因为如情找了整个大同的药材店，这些都是最大的了……”
“你……你……够了！”李骁气得话都说不出了，几乎从马上跌下来。但他气归气，仍是从这个角度望去，也没有错过如情唇边一闪而过的窃笑。心头电转，总算明白过来，他被这个巧言令色两面三刀的小丫头给整了。
content_en:
The survival rules of a concubine
Dai Wangfu is the highest-ranking dignitary in Shanxi. This year's reunion banquet was attended by almost all prominent figures in Datong. Among them, Prince Jing Li Xiao from Beijing was also invited, but the men and women were different and they were not in the same room. All the male guests were entertained by the prince and his son in front. After lunch, the women in the backyard left one after another on the pretext that they still had their mothers at home, or that they had young children at home with no one to take care of them.
Although Princess Dai was puzzled as to why these women, who usually loved to work in the camp, had their butts on fire today, she was indeed not in good spirits today. She had just offended General Zhenguo because of her daughter. The general of the town army, Jun Zhiyi, was on good terms with Prince Jing Li Xiao in Beijing. Li Xiao was currently in control of Shanxi's military affairs. He also had the eunuch Wang Zhi, Jin Yiwei fellow commander Zhang You and others under his command. Although Princess Dai didn't understand political affairs, she also knew that although the emperor had imprisoned the old prince, he was always wary of Prince Dai's palace and would always find ways to find out the dirt on Prince Dai's palace. Although Li Xiao and Dai Wang are uncles and nephews, they are still weak relatives in the Tian family. Furthermore, in the past few months, none of Li Xiao's actions were for the Prince's Palace. The eunuch Wang Zhi and the Jinyi Guards knew Zhang You. Although they were here to supervise Shanxi's military affairs, who didn't know that they were the emperor's spies? Nowadays, the scenery of the palace looks like a thin layer of ice. If you don't pay attention, you will fall into an abyss. But just now her daughter had treated General Zhenguo's girl with contempt and neglect, and she didn't dare to think about it any more. I hope she will worry more, and I hope the information she got is correct. How could Fang Zhiyi, a direct descendant, be so attached to a girl from a concubine?
But no matter what, Princess Dai still put down her old face, and when Ruqing was about to leave, she personally held Ruqing's hand and apologized, "My son was offended just now, please don't worry about it. My girl is young and energetic, and she is not sensible. If If there is anything wrong with me, please forgive me." He then took a sandalwood box from the girl's hand and handed it to Ruqing in person, "This is a little thought for you, it can calm the girl's shock, and I don't want her to accept it."
Ruqing took the sandalwood box, and Lu smelled a faint scent of sandalwood, and was surprised. These royal palaces were really luxurious, even the boxes to put things in were so expensive. No wonder the emperor was jealous and started to cut the price. In fact, these grandsons and grandsons did not work in production, they only ate and drank, and they loved to cause trouble.
However, the internal slander was the internal slander, but Ruqing could not resist Princess Dai's insistence and had to accept it, but this time she felt a little guilty. She looked at Princess Dai's old face that could not be concealed by the best rouge, and felt very guilty, "I have probably disturbed your daughter's marriage to the family of the Governor of Guangdong and Guangxi. "I should be the one to apologize now, right?" Thinking about Mrs. Hong, who was at the same table with her, she changed her color on the spot when she saw the gray-green color on her handkerchief, and then arranged the dishes for her. During this period, she even changed places with other ladies to sit across from her and expressed her sincere greetings. This person is none other than the future mother-in-law of the acting royal princess and the wife of the Governor-General of Guangdong and Guangxi.
Ruqing hugged the heavy box, walked out of the Yimen, and got on the carriage, still thinking in her heart, hey, you can make such a fortune after being wronged once. But I wonder if this is considered bribery?
While I was thinking wildly, suddenly a familiar arrogant voice came from outside, "Stop."
Li Xiao was riding on a tall horse, wearing a black mink fur brocade cloak that made him look extraordinary. The white mink fur hat was inlaid with a bright gem, which contrasted with the bright eyes under the brim of the hat, making him look very majestic.
"Stop, I have something to say to you." Li Xiao tightened the reins, and the beautiful horse stood in front of Ruqing's chariot, forcing the driver to stop and rein in, and bowed his hands to Li Xiao, "Your Majesty, IThe girl in the family is not allowed to see her husband easily. The prince can tell the young man whatever he wants. "
Li Xiao snorted lightly, shook his riding crop, and said proudly: "I will only say a few words to your girl before leaving. "
Linglong, who was sitting in the carriage, was shocked and looked at Ruqing with a worried look on her face, "Girl, this person is really looking for trouble. "
Ru Qingwen sat quietly on the cushion covered with Xiangtan brocade blanket, only slightly opened a corner of the curtain, and replied lightly: "Your Majesty, I am polite here. May I ask what your Majesty has to say? "
Li Xiao rode his horse forward again and approached Ruqing's window. He saw that Ruqing only slightly opened a corner of the curtain, revealing only half of her face. Her face darkened, and she actually stepped down and asked in a deep voice: "Does the girl still like the gift I gave you earlier? "
Ruqing was stunned for a moment. Li Xiao also gave her a gift? Why didn't she know? Looking at Li Xiao suspiciously, she found that he was waiting for her answer with an expectant expression. Some thoughts came to his mind, but he said: "I like it, the prince is interested. Ruqing has not even thanked the prince in person. "
Now it was Li Xiao's turn to be suspicious. He wanted to bend down and take a closer look, but Ruqing simply lowered the curtain and only heard a muffled word from the car: "Your Highness, please respect yourself. "
Li Xiao straightened up immediately, his face and heart burning.
The curtain of the car window opened again, revealing his big eyes full of love, "What else do you want to ask me, Your Majesty?" "
"..." Li Xiao was suddenly stunned for a moment, and when he looked closely, he suddenly realized that this little girl's eyes were really beautiful. They were like the sparkling lake water under the blue sky and white clouds, like the clear springs in the mountains, and more like gems falling from the sky. They exuded an alluring starry sky, with a playful and biting hint of malice.
Ruqing smiled softly at him again, her big eyes flashing, "Since everything is okay, then Ruqing will take the first step. "
"etc. "Li Xiao called her to stop again. After Ruqing opened the curtain again, he suddenly couldn't find a reason to ask her to stop.
"Is there anything else, Your Majesty? "
"..." Li Xiao stared at her for a while, and suddenly asked: "A while ago, the General's Mansion sent someone to give me gifts, were you prepared for them? "
Ruqing smiled shyly, "Yes, the prince and his brother are sworn friends. My brother is a rough man, and he doesn't know how to prepare gifts. That's why Ruqing personally prepared a gift for the prince on behalf of his brother. Does the prince still like it? "
Li Xiao's face turned dark and he asked coldly: "Who asked you to give me medicinal wine and those... medicinal materials? "
Ruqing flashed her beautiful big eyes, with an innocent look on her face, "Ruqing has read medical books, and uses wolfberry, dogwood, Morinda officinalis, calamus, Digupi, raspberry, dodder..."
"That's enough. "Li Xiao saw that she was seriously reciting it and stopped him quickly. His face turned darker and he stared at her gloomily, "You are a girl, how dare you take these as gifts? "
Ruqing flashed her innocent eyes and said in confusion: "I know, there are two concubines and four concubines in the prince's palace. Now there are several concubines around the prince. Ruqing thought maybe the prince should use it..." She looked at Li Xiao sincerely, "Why, the prince doesn't like it?" In order to prepare a gift for the prince, Ruqing specially consulted the doctor in the medicine shop..." Ruqing seemed to have noticed something was wrong with Li Xiao's face at this time, as if smoke was about to come out of his head. He swallowed his saliva and said in a low voice: "Uh, prince, do you think the bullwhip and tiger bone are too small? This can’t be blamed on Ruqing, because Ruqing has found all the medicinal stores in Datong, and these are the biggest..."
"You...you...enough! "Li Xiao was so angry that he couldn't speak and almost fell off the horse. But he was so angry that he still looked from this angle and did not miss the flash of a snicker on Ruqing's lips. His heart was spinning, and he finally understood that he had been tricked by this clever and duplicitous little girl.
